slides.title: The budget that finally stuck
slides.body: No spreadsheets. No willpower. Steal it →

slides.title: Why yours failed
slides.body: If it depends on you being 'disciplined' daily, it's already dead.

slides.title: The 50 / 30 / 20 rule
slides.body: Split every paycheck into 3 buckets — automatically.

slides.title: 50% — Needs
slides.body: Rent, food, bills, transport, minimum debt payments.

slides.title: 30% — Wants
slides.body: Eating out, fun, shopping. Guilt-free, because it's planned.

slides.title: 20% — Future
slides.body: Savings, investing, extra debt payoff. Pay yourself FIRST.

slides.title: The trick: automate it
slides.body: Auto-split on payday so the money's gone before you can spend it.

slides.title: Save this
slides.body: Set it up once. Follow for the automated money system.
